cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat; please protect the polish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull the table down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait! You'll slide the cup. Use the stepladder and lift it straight up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll step onto the tabletop from the ladder. My boots are muddy, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely not. Stay on the ladder; I'll hold it. We are not adding boot prints to the water ring.

reason: Make the proposed step onto the table explicit so the final footprint correction follows spoken facts; keep A calmly accommodating levitation.
